items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: He played, uh, sax with us too.

ctx.x: You got soprano first? Yeah, I started, I started and stayed with the soprano for a long time. I guess I played the soprano over a year before I finally switched over to the alto. And I was on, I stayed on the alto. Uh-huh. Well, tell me a little bit about these, these men and the, uh, five New Orleans jazz babies.

Didn't you say Cassard was in here? Jules? Yes, that's the first one on the line. And what did he play at that time? He played piano. Yeah, well, I've heard him play bass, but I've never heard it on the record.
Well, bass was his, bass was his, uh, real instrument, you see. But he played lots of jazz.
